solo_brief.default_briefing: Explain this material back to a busy product leader who wants to absorb it on a commute. Break it into clear, digestible parts with concrete examples. Teaching tone — accessible but accurate. No fluff, no reintroductions.

two_pm.default_briefing: An interview-style conversation between two PMs about this material. The expert leads with concrete examples and named artifacts; the generalist asks the clarifying questions a listener would, and forces the 'so what'. Keep it grounded, no abstraction without an example first.

strategy_debate.default_briefing: A structured debate on the strategic call inside this material. One speaker argues for moving now with what exists (two-way-door, reversible); the other probes the assumptions and names the one-way doors. Surface the real tradeoffs, don't manufacture agreement. End with where they actually land.

exec_readout.default_briefing: Turn this deck or document into a spoken executive readout. Host frames each section headline-first; analyst unpacks the number, separates fact from inference, and flags the risks. Crisp and decision-oriented — what it means and what to do, not background.
